description: An image of the screen, for a visual judgement only: read_screen is cheaper and gives refs. Returns it (at most 800 px unless width) with its scale to tap units; points: 1 pixel is 1 unit. watchMs: no image, what moved (way, speed, jumps); strip: 8 timed frames. file: full size to a .png, .jpg or folder; inline: false hides it; overwrite. An unchanged screen gets no second image. Visual diffs: check_screen; video: record_session.
name: take_screenshot
title: Screenshot
